summary: TOP Financial Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that it received Nasdaq confirmation of regaining compliance with the minimum bid price requirement. The company had been notified on April 28, 2026 that its Class A ordinary shares fell below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. Nasdaq confirmed that for the 10 consecutive business days from June 3 to June 16, 2026, the closing bid price was $1.00 or greater, closing the matter. This is a routine compliance update with no terms, recommendations, structural changes, or risk arbitrage implications.
